citation: i2spec, B MLR refitted to the dissociation limit with the Orsay atlas Partie IV (2026-09-29). Not a published parameter set.
fitted_to: mlr_b_2026c's targets (published B levels v' <= 30 at 3 MHz; every 127I2 absolute frequency with v'' <= 17, now at every v', at hypot(sigma, 1 MHz), 30 MHz above v' = 50) plus 2 009 unblended lines of the Orsay atlas Partie IV (v' = 51-79) at hypot(eps, 1.5 mK) with one atlas offset (prior 123(10) MHz from the three lines also measured against a comb). 20 beta, and a constant q_far added to the published alpha(R) beyond 5 A. Result: published 4.7 MHz rms, measured 9.0; atlas median |d| 31-35 MHz at v' = 51-66, 81-95 at 67-79. The fitted atlas offset, +290 MHz against the comb's +123, is where the potential cannot join v' <= 50 to v' = 52-62; level_corrections_2026j carries the measured levels. prototypes/mlr_b_dissociation.py
born_oppenheimer: taken from i2spec2026a B (alpha and V_ad, including the V_ad constant)
